_comment: Sample fixtures the review UI offers in its picker. This is CONFIG, not logic: the same shape as scripts/eval_status_decks.py's CASES and render_sample_deck.py's DECK_TYPE_DEFAULTS. Each entry names a frozen packet plus the company/project the request carries (the FixtureProvider returns the packet regardless; client_short is read from the packet). Paths are relative to the repo root. Add a client by adding one entry. A reviewer can also override company/project/check_in_date per run, or point at any other packet path.
